text: OVERDOSAGE Symptoms and Signs In cases of overdosage with Lariam, the symptoms mentioned under ADVERSE REACTIONS may be more pronounced. Treatment Patients should be managed by symptomatic and supportive care following Lariam overdose. There are no specific antidotes. Monitor cardiac function (if possible by ECG) and neuropsychiatric status for at least 24 hours. Provide symptomatic and intensive supportive treatment as required, particularly for cardiovascular disturbances.
